U.S. Senator Jacky Rosen is a fighter for hardworking families, an independent voice standing up for Nevada, and a bipartisan problem solver who knows how to bring people together and work across party lines to get results.
Jacky is running for reelection to continue delivering for Nevadans. She is focused on getting things done and not playing the same old Washington games, which is why she’s ranked as one of the most bipartisan, independent, and effective Senators. In the Senate, she has never hesitated to take on powerful special interests to bring down costs for hardworking Nevada families. Jacky puts Nevada first and will work with anyone – Republican, Democrat, or Independent – to do what’s right for our state.

## Lowering Costs and Growing Our Economy
Hardworking Nevadans are being squeezed by rising costs on everyday needs like housing, gas, groceries, child care, and so much more. In the Senate, Jacky is working to lower costs for the middle class, give families more breathing room, and build an economy that levels the playing field for workers and small businesses.
Jacky helped pass a historic new law that caps the price of insulin at $35 per month for seniors and gives Medicare the power to negotiate lower prescription drug costs, and she’s continuing the fight to cap insulin costs and make medications more affordable for all Americans. She is taking on Big Oil’s price gouging and working to protect Nevadans from even higher gas prices at the pump. She is also pushing to build more housing that regular Nevadans can afford, prevent grocery prices from increasing further, and leading a bipartisan effort to increase the availability of high-quality affordable child care for Nevada families. And Jacky supports cutting taxes for the middle class to provide more economic relief to families who need it most.
Jacky is also focused on growing Nevada’s economy for the future. She was one of the authors of the historic Bipartisan Infrastructure Law and played an important role in writing its provisions to expand broadband access and modernize airports across the country. This new law she helped write and pass is already creating thousands of good-paying union jobs and delivering billions of dollars in project funding to Nevada for safer roads, better airports, faster internet, clean drinking water, and much more. Jacky also successfully led the bipartisan effort to secure $3 billion from the federal government to make the long-awaited high-speed rail infrastructure project connecting Southern California to Las Vegas a reality.
Driving Nevada’s unique economy forward is a key priority for Jacky. As Chair of the Senate’s subcommittee overseeing tourism, Jacky has successfully fought to enhance federal support for travel and hospitality to ensure Nevada’s top industry continues to thrive. As a member of the Senate’s Small Business and Entrepreneurship Committee, Jacky is working across the aisle to cut red tape for small business startups and expand entrepreneurship opportunities for students at Minority Serving Institutions. Jacky also knows that Nevada’s economy depends on fostering new industries, like cannabis, which is why she is working tirelessly to ensure equal access to federal small business resources and banking services for the cannabis industry.
## Support Jacky Rosen

pages.title: Reforming Washington - Jacky Rosen
pages.text:
BREAKING: I am the OFFICIAL Democratic nominee for the U.S. Senate in Nevada. With The Cook Political Report calling Nevada "the most perilous" swing state for Democrats and Trump recently endorsing my opponent, Sam Brown, I need your help. Please, will you chip in now to help win this crucial battleground state?
IT’S OFFICIAL: Jacky’s running against Trump-endorsed extremist Sam Brown.
## Reforming Washington
Jacky is making sure Congress works for the people and rejecting the same old Washington games. She’s leading efforts to reform Washington by preventing Members of Congress from collecting paychecks if they fail to pass a budget on time and passing her bipartisan bill to ensure corrupt members of Congress lose their taxpayer-funded pensions. She is backing legislation to crack down on the influence of lobbyists in Washington by banning former members of Congress from lobbying and increasing transparency and accountability.
Reforming how Washington works also means fixing our broken campaign finance system. The Supreme Court’s Citizens United decision changed the landscape of our democracy, allowing billionaires and corporate special interests to pump unlimited amounts of money into our elections. Jacky supports a constitutional amendment to overturn this disastrous decision and return power to the voters.
## Support Jacky Rosen

## Expanding Access to Health Care
Jacky will always put Nevada’s families ahead of the politicians and special interests in Washington who want to threaten access to quality, affordable health care. She is fighting every single day to lower the cost of health care and prescription drugs, address the physicians and nurses shortage affecting Nevada, and expand access to telemedicine and rural health care.
In the Senate, Jacky helped pass a new law to lower costs for Nevadans by capping the price of insulin at $35 for seniors and empowering Medicare to negotiate lower drug prices, and she passed her bipartisan legislation to expand mobile health clinics to increase access to health care for underserved areas in Nevada. Jacky is also pushing to ensure rural Nevadans have access to the reliable, affordable health care they deserve by introducing bipartisan legislation that would incentivize medical providers to work in Nevada’s underserved communities. She is working to lower costs for family caregivers and standing strong to protect Medicare benefits for our seniors.
## Support Jacky Rosen

pages.text:

## Making Housing More Affordable
Let’s face it; the sky-rocketing costs of buying a house or affording rent have gotten out of control. These increasing prices are putting an untenable strain on hardworking Nevadans, and Jacky is taking action to solve the problem.
Jacky helped secure $500 million for the state of Nevada to create more housing options for hardworking families through the American Rescue Plan, including millions of dollars for rural areas.
With a surge in institutional investors buying up single-family homes, Jacky is working to prevent price gouging in the housing market and crack down on these corporate investors driving up housing costs across the state. She helped introduce a new plan to lower costs and cut taxes for first-time homebuyers who need down payment assistance. And as Nevada’s biggest cities continue to grow, Jacky is leading ongoing efforts to open up thousands of acres of federally owned land in Washoe County to build more housing that Nevadans can afford.
## Support Jacky Rosen

## Standing up for Reproductive Freedom
Jacky strongly supports a woman’s right to make her own health care decisions – free from interference from politicians. She will always stand up for Nevadans’ reproductive freedom and fight back against extreme Republicans’ attempts to ban abortion nationwide.
After the Supreme Court overturned Roe v. Wade , Jacky has been speaking out to enshrine reproductive rights in federal law and fighting back against Republican attacks on abortion rights. Jacky helped introduce the Women’s Health Protection Act, which would codify the protections of Roe v. Wade in federal law and defend women’s access to critical reproductive care. She has also championed legislation to protect women and doctors from prosecution by anti-abortion states for seeking reproductive care in states like Nevada. And she has stood strong against attacks from anti-abortion judges seeking to ban access to FDA-approved abortion medications that have been used safely by women for decades.
Thousands of Nevada women rely on Planned Parenthood health centers for preventive services like birth control and cancer screenings, and Jacky opposes partisan efforts to defund the organization. Thanks to her strong record of standing up for reproductive freedom, Jacky has been endorsed by trusted pro-choice organizations like Planned Parenthood Action Fund, Reproductive Freedom for All, and EMILYs List.
## Support Jacky Rosen
